column1: New model: Inkling 2 Mini (thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini), listed on OpenRouter 21 Nov 2026. $0.075 in / $0.30 out per million tokens.

Control: GPT-5.6 Luna (openai/gpt-5.6-luna), July 2026, so it was available before Ivy launched. Same prompt as the new model. It shows how much of any gain comes from the instructions rather than a newer model.
Judge for facts and answers: GLM-5.3-Flash (z-ai/glm-5.3-flash), 3 runs per reply, majority.
We were not given Ivy's prompt or model. Ivy's live replies look templated: 367 messages are about 13 fixed texts with the name and studio swapped in.
Both models got the same rebuilt prompt (analysis/ivy_prompt.md in the repo): the full fact sheet plus the lead's name, channel and message. No hints from the eval were added.
The sending system, not the model, chooses SMS or email, so C3 does not apply to the models.
Neither model had studio class schedules or the booking system, which Ivy has. This affects E11 and E18.
Every fail was checked by hand. Hand changes are in the Hand check column.
